# `handbook/` — multi-section PDF

**Manifest id:** `handbook-en-v1` · **File:** `handbook-en-v1.pdf` · **Status:** AUTHORED — generated by `../../../tools/generate_corpus.py`

## Retrieval property exercised

Heading-aware chunking and **direct factual lookup**. This is the baseline fixture: prose
organised into real headings, with each fact stated exactly once, in one section, in one
sentence. When a factual case against this document fails, the cause is retrieval or the
prompt — never the document.

It is also the **content-layer** fixture on the PDF side: every page carries a footer, and the
revision string exists **nowhere but that footer**. If `iterate_items` reverts to a body-only
walk, the footer vanishes and case `f-005` stops being answerable — a targeted, unambiguous
signal rather than a diffuse quality dip.

## What the fixture must contain

A 14-page, digitally-generated PDF (no scanning, no image-only pages — that is `scanned/`'s
job). Real PDF heading structure, not bold body text: H1 per section, H2 per subsection, H3
where noted.

**Title page:** "Kelpwright Instruments — Employee Handbook — Effective 2026-02-01".
The revision letter is deliberately **absent** from the title page and from every body
paragraph. It appears only in the page footer, below.

**Every page footer, identical on all 14 pages:**
`Kelpwright Instruments · Employee Handbook · Revision H · Page N of 14`

**Sections and the facts each must state, once, verbatim in substance:**

| § | Heading | Load-bearing facts |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Welcome | Company is fictional; instruments measure water quality; HQ in Fairmont, Coastland. |
| 2 | Working hours | Standard week is **38 hours**. Core hours are **10:00–16:00**, Monday to Friday. Time outside core hours is flexible with manager agreement. |
| 2.1 | Remote work | Up to **2 days per week**. Requires **manager approval**. **Not available during the first 3 months** of employment. |
| 3 | Leave | Annual leave is **26 days**, plus **1 additional day for every 5 completed years of service**, capped at **30 days**. Up to **5 unused days** may be carried into the next year and must be used by **31 March**. |
| 3.1 | Sickness | Self-certification for up to **3 consecutive days**; a medical certificate is required from day 4. |
| 4 | Probation and notice | Probation is **6 months**. Notice after probation is **8 weeks** on either side; during probation it is **2 weeks**. |
| 5 | Equipment | Laptops are refreshed every **4 years**. Instruments loaned for field work are booked through the service desk. |
| 6 | Expenses | Pointer only: *"Travel and subsistence are governed by the Travel and Expenses Policy."* No rates here — the rates live in `policy/` and duplicating them would make a date-sensitive case ambiguous by accident. |
| 7 | Contacts | People Operations: `people-ops@kelpwright.example`. IT service desk: **extension 4120**. No mobile numbers anywhere in the document (this is what makes unanswerable case `u-008` unanswerable). |

## What the fixture must NOT contain

- **Any mention of parental, maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.** Case `u-001` asks about
  parental leave precisely because §3 covers leave thoroughly and this one is absent. A helpful
  sentence added here silently deletes that case's meaning.
- Any per-diem or mileage figure (those belong to `policy/`).
- Any part code or price (those belong to `pricing/`).
- Any real person's name, email, or phone number.

`f-001` `f-002` `f-003` `f-005`, `a-002`, `a-004`, `fu-002`, and — by requiring its *absence* —
